p0032_1.t: Summary Table: Land, Population and Cultivated Land
p0032_1.d: Gives, by year from 1909, the area of privately owned land, the population of Japan proper and the territories, births, deaths and natural increase in Japan proper, and the area of paddy and other cultivated land in Japan proper and the territories.

p0032_2.d: Gives, by year from 1909 to 1933, the value of principal forest products, the number of fishermen, the value of the principal fish catch and of marine manufactures, and salt output, for Japan proper and the territories.

p0032_3.d: Gives, by year from 1909 to 1933, the number of mining concessions, miners and the value of mineral output, and the number of factories and factory workers, for Japan proper and the territories.

p0033_1.t: Summary Table: Commerce, Banking, Finance and Trade
p0033_1.d: Gives, by year from 1909 to 1934, the number of companies with their paid-up capital and reserves in Japan proper and the territories, currency in circulation, ordinary bank deposits and loans, and related financial and trade series.

p0033_2.d: Gives, by year from 1909 to 1934, railway route length, passengers, goods and traffic receipts for Japan proper and the territories, together with postal, telegraph, shipping and aviation series.

p0034_1.t: Summary Table: Labour, Education, Public Health and Justice
p0034_1.d: Gives, by year from 1909 to 1935, job offers, applicants and placements at public employment exchanges, labour and tenancy disputes with participants, and summary series on education, public health and justice.

p0034_2.t: Summary Table: Public Finance, Elections, Officials and Pensions
p0034_2.d: Gives, by year from 1909 to 1935, national defence and national debt expenditure, revenue and expenditure of prefectures, cities, and towns and villages, the outstanding national debt, local loans, and summary series on elections, officials and pensions.

p0035_1.d: Gives the place names and latitude and longitude of the eastern, western, northern and southern extreme points of the Empire as a whole and of each main island and territory.

p0035_2.d: Gives coastline length (main land and large and small islands, with their number) and area (main land and attached islands) by region, prefecture of Japan proper and territory.

p0036_1.d: Gives the area in hectares and the rental value of taxable paddy, upland, building land, forest and other categories of privately owned land and of tax-exempt land, by year (at the start of the year) and by prefecture.

p0037_1.d: Gives the area of Hokkaido other than privately owned land (national forest, government land, imperial estates, and undeveloped land sold, leased, in use or not yet disposed of), by year.

p0037_2.d: Gives the area of fixed-term (nenkichi) land in Hokkaido by category (paddy, upland, building land, forest, pasture, wasteland, miscellaneous and other), by year.

p0038_1.d: Gives, for each weather station, the barometer height, mean pressure, mean, extreme and departure-from-normal temperatures, humidity, sunshine percentage, precipitation and related data for 1934.

p0039_1.d: Gives the long-term average, the 1934 average and the values for January, April, July and October 1934 of pressure, temperature, humidity, precipitation and other elements at the principal weather stations.

p0040_1.d: Gives the census population by sex, density per km² and males per 100 females for the Empire, Japan proper and each territory at the censuses of 1 October 1935 and 1930.

p0041_1.d: Gives the estimated population by sex as of 1 October 1934, 1933 and 1932, by region and prefecture.

p0042_1.d: Gives the number of households and population by sex for each region and prefecture at the censuses of 1 October 1935 and 1930, with the increase over the five years.

p0043_1.t: Population by Age and Marital Status
p0043_1.d: Gives the population of Japan proper by single year of age and sex, broken down by marital status (single, married, widowed, divorced), at the census of 1 October 1930.

p0044_1.d: Gives the population by sex born in the same municipality, elsewhere in the same prefecture, in another prefecture and outside Japan proper, by prefecture at the census of 1930, with 1920 totals.

p0044_2.d: Gives the number of ordinary households surveyed, their members and the number of rooms they occupy, with rooms per household and persons per room, by prefecture at the census of 1930.

p0045_1.t: Ordinary Households and Population by Size of Household
p0045_1.d: Gives the number of ordinary households and their population by number of members (one person, two persons and so on), by prefecture at the census of 1930, with 1920 totals.

p0046_1.t: Ordinary Households and Population by Number of Rooms
p0046_1.d: Gives the number of ordinary households and their population by the number of rooms occupied (under one room, one room, two rooms and so on), by prefecture at the census of 1930.

p0047_1.t: Population by Occupation (Major Group): Industrial Status, Age and Marital Status
p0047_1.d: Gives the population in each major occupational group by industrial status (employer, own-account, employee), by age group and by marital status, at the census of 1930.

p0048_1.d: Gives the total and gainfully occupied population, and the number in each intermediate occupational group (cultivation, livestock etc.), with the number of males, by prefecture at the census of 1930.

p0051_1.t: Ordinary Households and Population by Industry (Intermediate Group) of the Household Head
p0051_1.d: Gives the number of ordinary households and their members by sex, distinguishing household heads and family members, by the industry of the household head (cultivation, livestock, sericulture etc.), at the census of 1930.

p0052_1.t: Daytime Population of the Large Cities
p0052_1.d: Gives the census population by sex of each ward of the large cities, the commuters and students travelling out of and into the area, and the resulting daytime population, at the census of 1930.

p0052_2.t: Municipalities and Population by Size Class
p0052_2.d: Gives the number of cities, towns and villages in Japan proper and their population in each population-size class, at censuses and year-end counts from 1898 to 1930.

p0053_1.t: Ordinary Households and Population of Cities
p0053_1.d: Gives the number of households and the population by sex of each city at the census of 1 October 1935, with its 1930 census population.

p0053_2.t: Ordinary Households and Population of Towns and Villages of 20,000 or More
p0053_2.d: Gives the number of ordinary households and the population by sex of each town and village with 20,000 or more inhabitants, with its prefecture, at the census of 1930, and its 1925 census population.

p0054_1.d: Gives the population of each prefecture by registered domicile (Japanese, Korean, Taiwanese, Karafuto, South Seas) and by foreign nationality (Chinese, Russian etc.), at the census of 1 October 1930 with 1920 totals.

p0054_2.d: Gives the Ainu population of Hokkaido at the end of each year by sex and the number of their births and deaths by sex, by year.

p0054_3.t: Marriages, Divorces, Births, Stillbirths and Deaths
p0054_3.d: Gives the numbers and rates per 1,000 population of marriages, divorces, births, stillbirths and deaths, and the excess of births over deaths, by year, by region and city for 1934 in Japan proper, and by year for Korea, Taiwan, Karafuto, Kwantung and the Railway Zone and the South Seas.

p0056_1.d: Gives the number and rate per 1,000 of marriages in Japan proper by type (ordinary, husband entering the wife's family, adopted son-in-law), by year, with marriages by age of husband and wife.

p0057_1.d: Gives the number and rate per 1,000 of divorces in Japan proper by which spouse left the household (wife leaving the husband's house, husband leaving the wife's house, both remaining), by year.

p0058_1.d: Gives the number of divorces in Japan proper by length of the marriage (single years under five years, then longer bands), by year.

p0058_2.d: Gives the number of births and stillbirths in Japan proper by sex, legitimate and illegitimate (including acknowledged), with the percentage of each, by year and by locality for 1934.

p0059_1.d: Gives the number of deaths in each month, by year.

p0059_2.d: Gives deaths in Japan proper by age (single years in early childhood, then age groups), by sex for 1934 and in total for 1930–1933, with rates per 1,000.

p0059_3.d: Gives deaths of infants under one year by sex for 1934 and totals for 1930–1933, with rates per 100 births, by prefecture.

p0060_1.d: Gives deaths in Japan proper in 1934 by detailed cause of death (typhoid and paratyphoid, typhus, smallpox, measles etc.), by sex, with rates per 1,000 deaths.

p0060_2.t: Deaths by Occupation (Intermediate Group) and Cause
p0060_2.d: Gives the number of deaths in 1934 by sex for each intermediate occupational group, broken down by principal cause of death (typhoid, measles, whooping cough etc.).

p0062_1.d: Gives deaths in Japan proper in 1934 from each principal cause (typhoid, measles, whooping cough, diphtheria, influenza, dysentery, tuberculosis etc.), by month of death.

p0062_2.d: Gives deaths in Japan proper in 1934 from each principal cause, by age group.

p0063_1.d: Gives deaths by sex from each principal cause, by prefecture of Japan proper for 1934 and for Korea, Kwantung and the Railway Zone, Taiwan and Karafuto for 1933.

p0065_1.d: Gives survivors, deaths, survival and mortality rates and life expectancy by age and sex from the life table for Japan proper based on 1926–1930.

p0066_1.t: Migrants into and out of Hokkaido
p0066_1.d: Gives the number of households and persons by sex moving to and leaving Hokkaido, by year.

p0066_2.d: Gives the number of persons arriving and departing by sex and by group (local people, other Japanese subjects, foreigners), by year, for the territories.

p0066_3.d: Gives the number of persons acquiring Japanese nationality (by marriage into a Japanese family, adoption, naturalisation) and recovering or losing it, by sex, by year.

p0066_4.d: Gives the number of persons issued passports by sex and by purpose of travel (official business, study, agriculture etc.), by year.

p0066_5.d: Gives the number of emigrants permitted to go abroad by sex, distinguishing those handled by emigration agents and others, and the number of returning emigrants, by year.

p0067_1.d: Gives the number of Japanese from Japan proper living abroad, by sex, by continent, country and consular district, as of 1 October 1934 (excluding Kwantung and the South Seas Mandate).

p0068_1.d: Gives the number of Japanese from Japan proper living abroad by sex and by occupation (agriculture, fisheries, mining etc.), by continent and country, as of the census date of 1 October 1930 (excluding Kwantung, the Railway Zone and the South Seas Mandate).

p0069_1.t: Foreigners Resident in Japan Proper by Nationality
p0069_1.d: Gives the number of foreign residents by sex and nationality (China, Manchukuo, Siam etc.) at the end of 1934.

p0069_2.t: Foreigners Resident in Japan Proper by Occupation
p0069_2.d: Gives the number of foreign residents (excluding temporary visitors) by sex and by occupation (agriculture and forestry, fishing and salt making, mining and industry, commerce etc.), by year and by prefecture.

p0069_3.t: Staff of Foreign Diplomatic and Consular Missions in Japan
p0069_3.d: Gives the number of staff of embassies and legations and of consulates in Japan (excluding those temporarily absent or not yet arrived), by year and by country.

p0070_1.d: Gives the area of cultivated land, paddy and upland fields, each split into owner-cultivated and tenanted, by year and by locality.

p0070_2.d: Gives the number of farm households by tenure (owner, tenant, part-owner part-tenant) and by size of holding cultivated, by year and by prefecture.

p0070_3.d: Gives the number of households owning cultivated land in Japan proper by size of holding (under 0.5 ha up to 49.59 ha and over), by year.

p0070_4.t: Land Managed by the Oriental Development Company
p0070_4.d: Gives the area of paddy, upland, forest and other land held by the Oriental Development Company in Korea, the number of settler households and the area allotted to them, by year.

p0071_1.d: Gives the area planted to rice (non-glutinous, glutinous, upland), barley, naked barley, wheat, oats, soybeans and other crops, by year and by locality.

p0072_1.d: Gives the harvest of rice (non-glutinous, glutinous, upland), barley, naked barley, wheat, oats, soybeans and other crops, by year and by locality.

p0073_1.t: Yield per Are of Agricultural Crops
p0073_1.d: Gives the yield per are of rice, barley, naked barley, wheat, oats, soybeans and other crops, by year and by prefecture.

p0073_2.d: Gives the total value of food, horticultural and industrial crops, the value of rice and of barley and wheat, and the value per head of population, by year and by prefecture.

p0074_1.d: Gives the number of silkworm-rearing households, quantity of eggs used, cocoon output by grade and value, in total and for the spring and summer-autumn crops, by year and by locality for 1934.

p0075_1.d: Gives the numbers of cattle and horses by sex and of stud animals by breed, pigs, sheep, goats and poultry, by year and by locality.

p0076_1.d: Gives the number of births and deaths of cattle, horses and other livestock in Japan proper by sex, with rates per 100 head at the end of the year, by year.

p0076_2.d: Gives the number of cases of rinderpest, anthrax, blackleg, bovine pleuropneumonia, contagious abortion, glanders, swine plague, hog cholera and other contagious livestock diseases in Japan proper, by year.

p0076_3.d: Gives the number of livestock markets (permanent, periodic, temporary) and the number of cattle, horses and other livestock exchanged and sold, with sale values and price per head, in Japan proper, by year.

p0076_4.d: Gives the number of slaughterhouses and the number and value of cattle, calves, horses, pigs and other animals slaughtered, by year and by locality.

p0077_1.d: Gives the number of dairies and milch cows of dairy businesses and of farmers and others, and the quantity and value of milk produced, by year and by locality.

p0077_2.d: Gives the number of factories and the total value and the quantity and value of condensed milk, butter, margarine and other products, by year and by prefecture for 1933.

p0078_1.d: Gives the output of plums, peaches, Japanese and Western pears, fresh and dried persimmons, apples, grapes, mandarins and other citrus and fruits, by year and by prefecture.

p0078_2.d: Gives the area of stocked and unstocked forest land by ownership (imperial, national, public, shrine and temple, private), by survey year and by locality.

p0079_1.d: Gives the area newly planted and naturally regenerated (private and national and other), replanting, bamboo planting, and the value of forest products, by year and by locality.

p0079_2.d: Gives the number of hunting licences issued, class A and class B, by hunting year (16 April to 15 April) and by prefecture.

p0080_1.d: Gives the number of sites and area of protection forests by ownership (imperial, national, public, shrine and temple etc.), by year, by type and by prefecture.

p0080_2.d: Gives the number of fishermen (full-time and part-time) and of fishing boats by size and propulsion, by year and by prefecture.

p0081_1.d: Gives the total value and the value of the catch of sardines, bonito, mackerel, tuna, yellowtail, sharks, sea bream and other species, by year and by locality.

p0082_1.d: Gives the total value and the value of dried bonito and tuna, dried squid, shark fins, herring and roe, other dried, salted and boiled products, fertiliser, fish oil, laver and other marine manufactures, by year and by locality.

p0083_1.d: Gives the quantity and value of the catch of offshore fisheries off Japan proper by method (purse seine, trawl, gill net, long line etc.) and of fishing in distant waters, by year.

p0083_2.d: Gives the number and area of aquaculture farms at the end of the year and the quantity and value of the harvest, by kind of product and by year.

p0083_3.d: Gives the number of saltworks, workers, area of salt fields, number of boiling pans, salt output and output per head of population, by year and by locality.

p0084_1.d: Gives the number of industrial cooperatives by type (credit, marketing, purchasing, utility and combinations), by year and by prefecture.

p0085_1.d: Gives the number of fishery associations, marine products associations, forestry associations and other trade associations with their members, and of their federations with member associations, by year and by prefecture.

p0085_2.d: Gives the number and area of working and idle mining concessions at year end, by year (excluding prospecting and state mines).

p0086_1.d: Gives the quantity and value of gold, silver, copper, lead, tin, zinc, iron, iron pyrites, coal and other minerals produced, by year and by locality for 1933.

p0087_1.d: Gives the number of factories and of workers, with the number of males, in each principal industry with annual output over 100 million yen (silk reeling, cotton spinning, wool spinning etc.), by year and by prefecture.

p0089_1.d: Gives the value of output of each principal industrial product with annual output over 50 million yen (raw silk, cotton yarn, spun silk, woollen yarn, cotton, silk, woollen and rayon fabrics, knitwear etc.), by year and by prefecture.

p0091_1.d: Gives the number of filatures by number of basins, operatives by sex and the quantity and value of raw silk produced, by year and by locality.

p0091_2.d: Gives the value of silk, silk-cotton mixed, cotton, hemp and wool fabrics, by year and by locality.

p0092_1.d: Gives the value of each kind of silk, cotton, hemp, wool and other fabrics (crepe, habutae, pongee, Fuji silk etc.) produced in 1933.

p0092_2.d: Gives the area harvested, quantity collected and compensation paid for fresh ginseng, and the output of red ginseng with its yield ratios, by year (excluding trial collections).

p0092_3.t: Sugar and Opium Manufacture in Taiwan
p0092_3.d: Gives the quantity and value of centrifugal sugar, non-centrifugal sugar and molasses produced in Taiwan and of opium preparations, by year.

p0092_4.d: Gives the output of coal in Japan proper by grade (lump, slack, run-of-mine, other coal and anthracite), by year.

p0092_5.d: Gives the output of petroleum products in Japan proper (gasoline, kerosene, light oil, lubricating oil, heavy oil, wax, asphalt, pitch etc.), by year.

p0093_1.d: Gives the number of applications for and registrations of patents, utility models and designs, with registrations by Japanese and foreigners, by year.

p0093_2.t: Patents and Utility Models by Class

p0093_3.d: Gives the number of electricity supply and electric railway undertakings (supply only, railway only, combined) and of private-use electrical installations in Japan proper, by year.

p0093_4.d: Gives the number of power stations in Japan proper by motive power (water, steam, internal combustion) and by authorised maximum output class, by year.

p0094_1.d: Gives the number of consumers and lamps for electric lighting, lamps per 100 population, and electric power used by industry, mining, agriculture and fisheries and others, by year and by locality.

p0094_2.d: Gives the number of gas undertakings, paid-up capital, burners installed for lighting and heating, gas engines supplied and their horsepower, gas supplied and coke produced, by year and by locality.

p0095_1.t: Weights and Measures and Measuring Instruments
p0095_1.d: Gives the number of measures of length, capacity and weight, gas meters and water meters verified and the percentage rejected, by year.

p0095_2.d: Gives the number of chambers, members, voters (with or without eligibility for election) and annual expenditure, by year and by prefecture.

p0095_3.d: Gives the number of exchanges, brokers and paid-up capital at fiscal year end, revenue (including brokerage commissions), expenditure (including the exchange tax), net profit or loss and dividends, by year and by prefecture.

p0096_1.d: Gives the number of exchanges and the volume of trading and deliveries in clearing (futures) transactions in stocks, rice and other commodities, by year.

p0096_2.d: Gives the monthly average futures prices per koku on each rice exchange, by year and by prefecture and exchange.

p0097_1.d: Gives wholesale prices and public-market retail prices of rice, barley, wheat, soybeans and other commodities in Tokyo, Osaka, Kobe, Kyoto, Nagoya and Yokohama, 1931 to 1934 and January–June 1935.

p0100_1.d: Gives the number of companies and their paid-up capital in Japan proper by capital-size class, by industry and by legal form, by year.

p0104_1.d: Gives the number of head offices and branches, paid-up capital and reserves at year end, receipts, payments, net profit and dividends with rate, by year and by class of bank.

p0105_1.d: Gives the year-end note issue (with excess issue), issue against specie reserve and fiduciary issue, gold paid out against and received for notes, and the ratio of the specie reserve, by year.

p0105_2.d: Gives the Bank of Japan's daily rates for loans secured on and bills guaranteed by government bonds, loans and bills on other security, local and other commercial bills, and overdrafts, at each date of change from 1927.

p0105_3.t: Bills of Exchange of the Yokohama Specie Bank
p0105_3.d: Gives the amount of bills bought and sold, collection bills, deposit bills and interest-bearing bills of the Yokohama Specie Bank, drawn on and received from other places, by year and by type.

p0105_4.d: Gives the year-end issue, reserves (specie and bullion, and fiduciary) and total annual issue of Yokohama Specie Bank notes denominated in taels, dollars and silver yen, by year.

p0105_5.d: Gives the year-end specie holdings, by owner (government, Bank of Japan) and by location (Japan proper, abroad), by year.

p0105_6.d: Gives the year-end amount of currency in circulation: small notes, Bank of Japan notes (issued and net of bank reserves), Bank of Korea and Bank of Taiwan notes and subsidiary coins, by year.

p0105_7.d: Gives the debentures of the Hypothec Bank of Japan brought forward, issued during the year, redeemed and outstanding at year end, by year.

p0106_1.t: Loans of the Hypothec Bank of Japan
p0106_1.d: Gives the loans outstanding of the Hypothec Bank of Japan by term of loan and other categories, at the end of 1931, 1932 and 1933.

p0106_2.t: Debentures of the Agricultural and Industrial Banks
p0106_2.d: Gives the debentures of the agricultural and industrial banks brought forward, issued, redeemed and outstanding at year end, by year.

p0106_3.t: Loans of the Agricultural and Industrial Banks
p0106_3.d: Gives the loans outstanding of the agricultural and industrial banks by borrower (public bodies, irrigation associations, farmers, industrialists, merchants etc.), at the end of 1931, 1932 and 1933.

p0107_1.d: Gives the debentures of the Hokkaido Colonial Bank brought forward, issued, redeemed and outstanding at year end, by year.

p0107_2.t: Loans of the Hokkaido Colonial Bank
p0107_2.d: Gives the loans of the Hokkaido Colonial Bank by term and by kind of security, for fiscal 1932 and 1933.

p0107_3.d: Gives the year-end note issue of the Bank of Taiwan, divided into issue against gold and silver specie reserve and fiduciary issue, by year.

p0107_4.d: Gives the year-end note issue of the Bank of Korea, divided into issue against gold, silver and Bank of Japan note reserves and fiduciary issue, by year.

p0107_5.d: Gives the debentures of the Industrial Bank of Japan brought forward, issued, redeemed and outstanding at year end, by year.

p0108_1.d: Gives the number of head offices and branches, paid-up capital and reserves at year end, receipts, payments, net profit and loss and dividends of ordinary banks, by year and by locality.

p0108_2.d: Gives the number of head offices and branches, paid-up capital and reserves at year end, receipts, payments, net profit and loss and dividends of savings banks, by year and by locality.

p0109_1.d: Gives the number of head offices and branches, capital, reserves, cash, receipts, payments, net profit and dividends of trust companies in Japan proper, by year.

p0109_3.d: Gives the number of mujin head offices and branches, their capital and reserves, the number of groups and shares and the contracted benefits and instalments, by year, for Japan proper.

p0109_4.d: Gives the number of clearing houses, the number and value of bills cleared and of dishonoured bills, with value per bill and dishonoured bills per 100,000 cleared, by year and by month for 1934, for Japan proper.

p0109_5.d: Gives the number and value of bills cleared and the value per bill in Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto and the other principal cities, by year and by month for 1934.

p0110_1.d: Gives the highest and lowest rates in June and December on fixed deposits, loans on deeds and discounted bills, by year from 1925 and by locality for 1934.

p0110_2.d: Gives the highest, lowest and average telegraphic transfer selling rates of the Yokohama Specie Bank on New York, London, Paris and other centres, by year and by month.

p0111_1.d: Gives the number and amount of domestic money orders issued and paid, by year and by locality.

p0115_1.d: Gives the number of policies and sums insured for new contracts, revivals, deaths, maturities, surrenders and lapses and contracts outstanding, by year and by locality.

p0118_1.d: Gives the value of exports of domestic goods, re-exports of foreign goods and special exports, and imports of foreign goods and re-imports of domestic goods, for Japan proper by year.

p0118_2.d: Gives the value of exports and imports of Japan proper by class (raw foodstuffs, manufactured foodstuffs, raw materials, semi-manufactures, finished manufactures, others), by year.

p0122_1.t: Imports and Shipments In by Commodity
